    AI Overview
    The 2026 Masters Tournament begins its first round on Thursday, April 9, with the honorary starters (Gary Player, Jack Nicklaus, Tom Watson) at 7:25 a.m. ET, followed by the first tee times at 7:40 a.m. ET. The second round on Friday, April 10, also starts at 7:40 a.m. ET. 
    Key 2026 Masters Start Times (ET): 
    • Thursday, April 9 (Round 1): First tee times start at 7:40 a.m. ET.
    • Friday, April 10 (Round 2): First tee times start at 7:40 a.m. ET.
    • Saturday, April 11 (Round 3): Tee times begin around 10:30 a.m. ET.
    • Sunday, April 12 (Round 4): Final round tee times start around 10:30 a.m. ET. 
    How to Watch: 
    • TV Coverage (Thurs/Fri): 3-7:30 p.m. ET on ESPN.
    • TV Coverage (Sat/Sun): 2-7 p.m. ET on CBS.
    • Streaming: Featured groups begin earlier via Masters.com and Paramount+. 
    Note: Times are approximate and subject to weather delays.

    AI Overview
    2026 Masters coverage begins early with streaming on Masters.com and the Masters App, featuring early groups at 9:15 a.m. ET, Amen Corner at 10:45 a.m. ET, and holes 4, 5 & 6 at 8:45 a.m. ET on Thursday and Friday. TV coverage on ESPN starts at 3 p.m. ET on both days, with afternoon coverage on CBS for the weekend. 
    2026 Masters TV & Streaming Schedule (All times Eastern) 
    • Thursday, April 9 (Round 1):
      • 9:15 a.m. – 7:30 p.m.: Featured Groups (Masters.com, Paramount+, ESPN+)
      • 10:45 a.m. – 6 p.m.:
        Amen Corner (Masters.com, Paramount+, ESPN+)
      • 1 p.m. – 3 p.m.: Early Coverage (Prime Video)
      • 3 p.m. – 7:30 p.m.: First Round Coverage (ESPN)
    • Friday, April 10 (Round 2):
      • 9:15 a.m. – 7:30 p.m.: Featured Groups (Masters.com, Paramount+, ESPN+)
      • 10:45 a.m. – 6 p.m.: Amen Corner (Masters.com, Paramount+, ESPN+)
      • 1 p.m. – 3 p.m.: Early Coverage (Prime Video)
      • 3 p.m. – 7:30 p.m.: Second Round Coverage (ESPN)
    • Saturday, April 11 (Round 3):
      • 10:15 a.m. – 7 p.m.: Featured Groups (Masters.com, Paramount+, ESPN+)
      • 2 p.m. – 7 p.m.: Third Round Coverage (CBS)
    • Sunday, April 12 (Final Round):
      • 10:15 a.m. – 7 p.m.: Featured Groups (Masters.com, Paramount+, ESPN+)
      • 2 p.m. – 7 p.m.: Final Round Coverage (CBS) 
    For a full, interactive viewing experience, check the official Masters Coverage Page for exact, up-to-the-minute updates, and check Prime Video for the early rounds.
